sectors.trend: Iron ore prices under pressure ('roaches seethe'); gold juniors (Forrestania, Aurum) show strength with new prefeasibility studies and high-grade discoveries. Coal policy uncertainty under Albo government.
sectors.implications: BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX face margin headwinds from soft iron ore. Gold names (WMC.AX, NGM.AX, GSR.AX) and juniors benefit from safe-haven flows. Coal (BOQ.AX, WDS.AX) faces policy risk.

sectors.trend: Big four banks advance on easing yields; however RBA warning and IMF spending-cut call signal further rate hikes. Mortgage rates near 7% stress NIMs and credit growth.
sectors.implications: CBA.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX, WBC.AX benefit from wider spreads but face rising credit-loss provisions. Rate-sensitive REITs (GPW.AX, ICPS.AX) under pressure.

sectors.trend: LNG exports to Japan surging while East Coast gas supply tightens; Middle East oil shock risk; petrol price shock hitting consumers; Victoria retreats from renewable transmission.
sectors.implications: SOL.AX, WDS.AX, GWO.AX benefit from LNG demand. Oil exposure (WDS.AX) faces geopolitical premium. Renewable/energy transition names (ARE.AX, LEM.AX) face policy headwinds in Victoria.

sectors.trend: Eli Lilly and Novo Nordisk weight-loss drug pipeline strong; flu spike pressures regional health services. CSL remains key Aus exposure.
sectors.implications: CSL.AX supported by global biotech momentum. Regional health service strain may drive government spending. LLY/NVO strength validates Aus healthcare sector.

sectors.trend: Coles milk price controversy; Qantas strike threat; EV adoption accelerating; visa changes threaten food security; housing unaffordability peaks.
sectors.implications: WES.AX, WOW.AX face margin pressure from input costs. QAN.AX exposed to strike risk. EV transition (SGM.AX, EV1.AX) gains structural tailwind. Housing (MRG.AX, LVH.AX) under affordability stress.

sectors.trend: Anthropic $31bn QLD datacentre deal; AI spending explosion; Corning-Verizon fiber deal; global high-yield issuance strong.
sectors.implications: Australian datacentre/infrastructure plays (WBC.AX, CGF.AX, VCN.AX) benefit. AI capex cycle supports global tech but raises valuation concerns.

key_themes: RBA tightening cycle vs recession risk – policy dilemma
Commodity divergence: iron ore weak, gold strong, LNG robust
Household stress: 7% mortgages, unaffordable housing, petrol shock
Geopolitical oil risk from Middle East
AI/datacentre capex as new Aus infrastructure theme
Immigration policy debate impacting labour supply and food security
Global 'four horsemen' macro risks (debt, trade, demographics, climate)

risk_assessment.risk_factor: RBA rate hike / IMF fiscal tightening
risk_assessment.mitigation: Overweight short-duration bonds; reduce rate-sensitive REIT and property exposure; favour fixed-income income streams.
Maintain defensive allocation (staples, healthcare, utilities); reduce cyclical mining and construction exposure.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Middle East oil shock / geopolitical escalation
risk_assessment.mitigation: Hedge energy exposure; monitor WDS.AX, SOL.AX; consider oil-linked ETFs as tactical hedge.
Reduce QAN.AX position ahead of strike vote; monitor travel-sector sentiment.
Underweight BHP.AX, FMG.AX, RIO.AX near-term; rotate into gold and diversified miners.
Monitor NAB.AX, ANZ.AX credit-loss provisions; reduce REIT exposure; watch tenant relief policy.

opportunities.rationale: Iron ore weakness and geopolitical risk support gold; Forrestania and Aurum prefeasibility studies signal sector momentum.

opportunities.recommendation: Add to big four banks on yield easing
opportunities.rationale: Banks advanced on falling yields; NIMs still supportive at 7% mortgage rates; dividend yield attractive.
Anthropic $31bn QLD deal signals structural AI capex inflow into Australia; long-term growth vector.
Japan LNG demand surging; Middle East oil shock risk supports energy premiums.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce cyclical mining and construction exposure
defensive_moves.rationale: Iron ore weakness, recession odds rising, and RBA tightening create headwinds for rate-sensitive and commodity-cyclical names.
7% mortgage rates and unaffordable housing cap rental yields and occupancy; tenant relief may compress margins.
Imminent strike threat over Joyce-era agreements creates binary event risk.
RBA hike imminent; IMF fiscal warning; recession probability rising – preserve capital for entry points.

market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely range-bound to slightly lower into RBA decision. Volatility elevated on oil/geopolitics. Banks and gold support index; mining and REITs drag. Expect 1–2% downside risk if RBA hikes 25bp.
market_outlook.long_term: 6–12 month outlook cautious. Recession risk by 2027, 7% mortgages, and IMF fiscal pressure cap upside. Structural positives: AI/datacentre capex, LNG demand, gold. Index likely trades in a 8,200–9,200 ^A200 range absent a major catalyst.
key_catalysts: US Fed policy and Buffett succession at Berkshire

Iron ore (62% Fe) spot and futures
CBA.AX, NAB.AX NIM and credit-loss guidance
